parsed.answer: Unfortunately, no. Our delivery windows run from 8:00 to 20:00 local time, so a 22:00 delivery isn't possible. Our policy doesn't offer evening slots after 20:00. Your parcel NW2001 is currently held at the depot after a failed attempt. You can book one free redelivery, and it must happen within 5 business days of the failed attempt, or the parcel goes back to the sender. If you'd like, you can choose a time within the 8:00–20:00 window that suits you best, for example a later one.
